questions.stem: A 70-year-old woman presents to the OPD with memory difficulty. The patient’s husband is concerned because she is having difficulty doing her finances such as paying bills. Memory impairment testing reveals the poor ability to generate lists of words or copy diagrams. There is no past medical history of diabetes,CAD,hypothryoidism and hypertension. On examination BP-120/70 mmHg, CVS-normal, CNS-no focal neurological deficit.Lab tests showed normal thyroid profile and serum vitamin B12 levels. Which of the following anatomic findings is most likely with her condition?
questions.stemHtml: A 70-year-old woman presents to the OPD with memory difficulty. The patient’s husband is concerned because she is having difficulty doing her finances such as paying bills. Memory impairment testing reveals the poor ability to generate lists of words or copy diagrams. There is no past medical history of diabetes,CAD,hypothryoidism and hypertension. On examination BP-120/70 mmHg, CVS-normal, CNS-no focal neurological deficit.Lab tests showed normal thyroid profile and serum vitamin B12 levels. Which of the following anatomic findings is most likely with her condition?

options.label: A
options.text: Atrophy of the medial temporal lobes

options.label: B
options.text: Atrophy of the entire frontal and temporal lobe
